name: Katsumoto (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Katsumoto town emblem in white: a stylised device of a pointed top and a swirl, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Katsumoto in Nagasaki Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-03-01.

features.role: Katsumoto town emblem — a stylised device of a pointed top and a swirl, like a stylised character
